verification.validation: Full SDK release gate and content scans are required before publication. DSM window WebAPI parameters and the session-token placement were checked against a DSM 7.4.1 test device: its sendWebAPI JSON-encodes every value (a pre-encoded list is refused with 401), and WebAPI refuses a SynoToken in a POST body (119) while accepting it in X-SYNO-TOKEN or the query; a DSM 7.1.1 test device answers the same. Executor sources and canonical tasks are unchanged and the current immutable executor inventory is reused.
